raw_manifest_json.TestingChangelog:
A clean interface that shows the user's gearsets in a scrollable table, where gearsets can be rearranged by drag and drop. Once the user is happy with the order of their gearsets, they can click apply to change them in game. The sorter has two methods: insert and swap. The mode method can be changed by clicking the button showing the mode.

Also has a window to preview the gearset. Shows the name of the gearsets, item level, items in gearset and attached materia. Once a user selects a gearset it'll show in the preview block, where they can select "Equip" to equip the gearset or "Update" (user must hold Left Ctrl to access) to apply currently equipped gear to the selected gearset.
